exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to have time, to find time
to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: успе́ть — to have time, to find time; услы́шать — to hear; упа́сть — to fall, to drop; уе́хать — to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance).
**ухожу** — уходи́ть (imperfective): to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); to escape, to evade; to resign, to retire; to be lost. Wiktionary: у- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **уходи** — уходи́ть (imperfective): to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); to escape, to evade; to resign, to retire; to be lost. Wiktionary: у- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **убил** — уби́ть (perfective): to kill; to murder; to beat (in cards); to drive to despair. Wiktionary: у- + бить.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to turn out well, to be a success
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: увида́ть — (colloquial) to see; усло́вие — condition; умира́ть — to die of natural causes; уда́ться — to turn out well, to be a success.
**уеду** — уе́хать (perfective): to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance). Wiktionary: у- + е́хать.
